originalSite.lede:
Let AI agents use your real iPhone. With iphone-use installed on your Mac, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client reads the phone's screen as text, taps, types and swipes in any app, including the ones with no API: Health, banking, chat apps, or the app you are testing. You can watch it live and take the phone back at any time.
让AI代理使用你的真实iPhone。在 Mac 上安装 iPhone 专用软件后，Claude Code、Codex 或任何 MCP 客户端都能将手机屏幕读取为文本，并识别任何应用中的点击、输入和滑动操作，包括那些没有 API 的应用，例如健康、银行、聊天应用或您正在测试的应用。您可以实时查看操作过程，并随时取回手机。

originalSite.lede:
Let AI agents use your real iPhone. With iphone-use installed on your Mac, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client reads the phone's screen as text, taps, types and swipes in any app, including the ones with no API: Health, banking, chat apps, or the app you are testing. You can watch it live and take the phone back at any time.
让AI代理使用你的真实iPhone。在你的Mac上安装iPhone时，Claude Code、Codex或任何MCP客户端都会将手机屏幕读取为文本，在任何应用中点击、输入和滑动，包括那些没有API的应用：健康、银行、聊天应用或你正在测试的应用。你可以随时观看直播，并把手机拿回去。
